newsitem.title: CANADA: M.L. Cass targets Hunt deal financing.
newsitem.headline: M.L. Cass targets Hunt deal financing.

text.p: M.L. Cass Petroleum Corp said on Tuesday that it has put together a team of underwriters to raise C$45 million for a proposed oil and gas project in the former Soviet republic of Kazakhstan.
The Alberta-based company said financing for the development of Karazhanbas onshore and offshore oil fields is expected to be completed by the end of November.

Michael Cass, the company's president, said the company acquired a 100 percent interest in the project as part of a reverse takeover in which it issued 14 million of its common shares to Texas-based Nelson Bunker and Hunt.
M.L. Cass shareholders will vote on the deal on December 30, Cass said.
